observed.reason: direct expert-slot GEMV is not implemented

acceptance_formula.fixture: The same deterministic IQ2_XXS expert bytes, selected IDs, weights, and input vector are used by both arms.
acceptance_formula.workload: At least 600 expert evaluations per arm after warmup.
acceptance_formula.timing: CUDA events bracket each complete arm and the terminal event is synchronized before elapsed time is read.
acceptance_formula.correctness: Every output float is bit-identical between compact-copy and direct-slot arms; all CUDA operations succeed.
acceptance_formula.performance: median(direct-slot completed milliseconds) / median(compact-copy plus GEMV completed milliseconds) <= 0.95 over at least five counterbalanced paired samples.
acceptance_formula.scope: This microgate only authorizes a serving candidate. It is not a serving-performance result and cannot adopt W3 by itself.

next_action: Implement the smallest default-off direct-slot decode kernel path using the same kernels exercised by this test. Stop W3 before a model run if this fixed microgate misses any acceptance condition.
